description.value: Canco Gas is a Canadian-owned independent gas station and convenience store in Christina Lake, part of the PR Petroleum-operated Canco chain with over 100 locations across Canada. The in-store 'One Stop by Canco' concept includes convenience retail and prepared food under the 'Chillerz Food 2 Go' brand. For touring cyclists passing through the Christina Lake corridor, it offers a practical stop for fuel, snacks, and supplies.

address.value: 1590 McGregor Frontage Road, Christina Lake, V0H 1E0
